nodes.label: Docs Discipline
nodes.rationale: Tick plan items, add ADRs and update architecture on changes, and refresh graphify so context recovery stays cheap.

nodes.label: Thin Routers, Logic in Services
nodes.rationale: Routers validate, call the service, return a schema; business logic is centralized in services.

nodes.label: Loading/Empty/Error States Rule
nodes.rationale: Every data view ships a layout-shaped skeleton, an empty state and an error state.

nodes.label: Ports and Adapters (offline fakes)
nodes.rationale: External deps hidden behind small interfaces so the app runs fully offline (CI, keyless demo) and providers stay swappable.

nodes.label: ADR-011: JavaScript Frontend (TypeScript declined)
nodes.rationale: User chose JavaScript; mitigated with Zod at API boundary, JSDoc, ESLint and Vitest.

nodes.label: ADR-012: Tailwind v4 plus Hand-Authored CSS Design System
nodes.norm_label: adr-012: tailwind v4 plus hand-authored css design system
nodes.rationale: Tailwind for speed, hand-written CSS tokens so the UI does not look like a Tailwind template.

nodes.label: Zero-API-Key Offline Mode
nodes.rationale: Every external dependency sits behind a port with an offline fake so the app runs and tests pass with no keys.

nodes.norm_label: upload -> extract -> review -> organize -> act flow

nodes.label: Upload -> Extract -> Review -> Organize -> Act Workflow
nodes.norm_label: upload -> extract -> review -> organize -> act workflow

nodes.label: Cross-Module Import Rule
nodes.rationale: Modules may import only another module's service.py/schemas.py, never routers or private helpers, to keep bounded-context seams clean.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith (API + Worker)
nodes.rationale: One FastAPI codebase deployed as two processes keeps dev/deploy simple while module seams allow later extraction.

nodes.label: ADR-001: Modular Monolith with Two Processes
nodes.norm_label: adr-001: modular monolith with two processes
nodes.rationale: Clear domain seams but single developer and portfolio budget; microservices add network hops and distributed transactions without user benefit.

nodes.label: ADR-007: Durable Job Queue with ARQ + Inline Fallback
nodes.norm_label: adr-007: durable job queue with arq + inline fallback
nodes.rationale: FastAPI BackgroundTasks are lost on restart; extraction needs retries. Inline mode keeps tests and free-tier demos single-process.

nodes.label: RAG Guardrails (cite-only, no diagnosis)
nodes.rationale: Answers only from provided sources with [n] citations; never diagnose or adjust doses; retrieval scoped by user_id in SQL.

nodes.label: ADR-004: Local Embeddings with fastembed
nodes.rationale: Groq has no embeddings endpoint; a second paid key hurts clone-and-run. bge-small-en-v1.5 runs free on CPU.

nodes.label: ADR-013: Synthetic Data Only, Explicit Non-Goals
nodes.norm_label: adr-013: synthetic data only, explicit non-goals
nodes.rationale: A portfolio app processing health records must not imply clinical use.

nodes.label: Secure Sharing Flow (hashed tokens, proxied files)
nodes.norm_label: secure sharing flow (hashed tokens, proxied files)

nodes.label: ADR-002: pgvector instead of FAISS
nodes.rationale: FAISS lives outside Postgres: dual-write consistency issues, no per-user isolation, index loss on ephemeral disks. pgvector gives cascade deletes and tenant isolation in WHERE.

nodes.label: ADR-010: Share Links Proxied through API, Tokens Hashed
nodes.norm_label: adr-010: share links proxied through api, tokens hashed
nodes.rationale: Presigned storage URLs cannot be revoked or audited once issued.

nodes.label: Extraction Pipeline (classify, extract, validate, normalize, draft)
nodes.norm_label: extraction pipeline (classify, extract, validate, normalize, draft)

nodes.label: ADR-003: Groq LLM behind Provider Interface
nodes.norm_label: adr-003: groq llm behind provider interface
nodes.rationale: Groq lacks PDF input; only qwen vision accepts images (<=3, JSON mode); strict json_schema only on gpt-oss. Hence text vs vision paths and a FakeLLM for keyless CI.

nodes.label: ADR-006: Deterministic Frequency Normalization
nodes.rationale: LLM-invented clock times are non-deterministic and untestable; a pure-Python parser maps frequency_raw to a Schedule with table-driven tests.

nodes.label: user_id Scoping on Every Query
nodes.rationale: Every user-owned table carries user_id; resources load by (id, user_id) so foreign IDs return 404 rather than leaking existence.

nodes.label: Rotating Refresh Tokens with Family Reuse Detection
nodes.norm_label: rotating refresh tokens with family reuse detection

nodes.label: ADR-008: Own Authentication; Google OAuth only for Integrations
nodes.norm_label: adr-008: own authentication; google oauth only for integrations
nodes.rationale: Sign in with Google would couple login to sensitive scopes and force verification for every user.

nodes.label: ADR-014: Same-Origin API for First-Party Auth Cookies
nodes.norm_label: adr-014: same-origin api for first-party auth cookies
nodes.rationale: Cross-site SPA/API makes SameSite=Lax cookies third-party and blocked; a same-origin /api proxy keeps cookies first-party and CSRF simple.

nodes.label: ADR-009: Draft -> Confirmed Lifecycle with Provenance
nodes.norm_label: adr-009: draft -> confirmed lifecycle with provenance
nodes.rationale: AI extraction is fallible; health data must not silently become truth. Only explicit confirmation creates records.

nodes.label: ADR-005: Calendar for Recurring Reminders, Tasks for One-off Actions
nodes.norm_label: adr-005: calendar for recurring reminders, tasks for one-off actions
nodes.rationale: Google Tasks drops time-of-day and has no recurrence, so dose reminders go to Calendar RRULE events.
